All 8 selected catalogue star positions and 8 introduced guide connections are retained. Centres use one uniform planar position factor, preserving the source north-up/east-left gnomonic shape; each star marker remains 8 mm diameter and guides are reconstructed between marker rims at unchanged physical line width. Source epoch is ICRS J1991.25; this is not a current observing or navigation chart, a physical connection, a brightness/size/distance encoding or a complete constellation boundary. Source epoch is ICRS J1991.25; this is not a current observing or navigation chart, a physical connection, a brightness/size/distance encoding or a complete constellation boundary. The external HIP-member and learned-name key remains necessary. These finite diagrams do not prove limiting behaviour.
